author: cayopoku
abstract: NeuroForge Next is a specialized engineering system for building premium SaaS applications with Next.js 16 (App Router first, Pages Router aware), React 19, Prisma, and TypeScript. It enforces a severity-tiered Analysis First workflow using NeuroForge memory files, server-first components with client islands at the leaves, Next.js 16's explicit caching model ('use cache', cacheLife, cacheTag, updateTag), authorization in the data access layer rather than proxy/middleware, schema-validated Server Actions that return expected errors instead of throwing them, TanStack Query and Zustand on the client, optional offline-first persistence with Dexie/IndexedDB, Strapi draft-mode integration, Laws of UX and accessibility standards, reusable shadcn/ui app wrappers, loud error surfacing with zero silent fallbacks, minimal why-only code comments, analytics that records real visitor geography, and senior SaaS engineering standards.
